name: execution-cloudflare-sandbox
title: Cloudflare sandbox host: a Linux container per sandbox and agent, served to execution-remote
description: A sandbox host on Cloudflare Containers speaking execution-serve's protocol: a container per sandbox id and agent, its image per agent, its workspace saved to storage.blob when idle and restored on first use; never given secrets.

environment.name: PIKIT_SANDBOX_TOKEN
environment.description: The token execution-remote clients send (the same value in their projects); at least 32 characters (for example `openssl rand -hex 32`). Never reaches a container.
